seoTitle: GCD and LCM Calculator with Euclidean Algorithm Steps
metaDescription: Find the greatest common divisor and least common multiple of two or more integers, with each Euclid division step. Free and exact.
intro: Computes GCD and LCM of a list of integers and prints every division step of the Euclidean algorithm.
why:
The Euclidean algorithm replaces the larger number by the remainder until the remainder is zero. Seeing each line, such as 1071 = 2 x 462 + 147, helps in class and when you need to show your work.

With more than two numbers the tool folds from left to right: it takes the GCD of the first two, then that result with the third, and so on, and builds the LCM the same way using lcm(a, b) = a / gcd(a, b) x b. Big integers are exact. Signs are ignored and zero is rejected to avoid trivial cases.
howTo: Enter two or more integers separated by spaces, commas or new lines.
Read the GCD and LCM at the top.
Follow the division steps below to see how the GCD was found.
Copy the result if you need it for a worksheet.

faq.q: How many numbers can I enter?
faq.a: Up to 30 integers of up to 60 digits each.
